board.trayEmpty: Every work order has a slot
board.empty: No work orders on this site in this window
board.instructions: To move a work order, focus it and press Space or M. Arrow keys choose a lane and a day, Enter drops, Escape cancels. Enter opens it, P pins it, Ctrl+Z undoes the last move.
board.undoMovedSince: {card} has moved since, so this move cannot be undone here
board.pick: Moving {card}, {minutes}, from {place}. Arrow keys choose where, Enter drops, Escape cancels.
board.targetTray: {place}: back to the work orders without a slot.
board.edge: No further lane or day that way.
board.edgeColumns: Use the left and right arrows to choose a column.
board.notMoved: {card} was not moved. It stays at {place}.
board.pinnedHeld: {card} is pinned and cannot move. Unpin it first.
board.overHeld: {place} would go over its capacity, and this site does not allow it.

load.sentenceOver: {label}: {booked} of {available} min booked, {pct}%, {over} min over capacity.
load.sentenceNone: {label}: no working time set, {booked} min booked.

lab.label: Planning board
lab.readOnly: Read-only: only planners move work orders. You can look at them and open them.
lab.offline: Offline — moves wait until the connection is back.
lab.errorReason: The server did not answer in time. Nothing is drawn, so an empty board is never shown by mistake.
lab.opened: Enter or a click opens {card}: its work order record.
